seo_prizes_summary_ordinary_time.comment: Longest bullet in the FotMob Predict World Cup 2026 prizes summary. Two parts joined by an em-dash: (1) which match phase the prediction refers to — 90 minutes + stoppage time, not extra time, not penalty shootout; (2) practical advice — if you expect knockout extra time, pick a draw. Use the locale's football-specific terms: "stoppage time" → injury time / Nachspielzeit / temps additionnel etc.; "extra time" → the extra 30 minutes after 90 (NOT stoppage time); "penalties" → penalty shootout (not penalty kicks during regular play); "knockout match" → elimination/knockout round game. Keep the em-dash structure if your locale uses em-dashes; otherwise use a sentence break.
seo_prizes_summary_ordinary_time.english: All predictions are for the score at the end of 90 minutes (plus stoppage time). Extra time and penalties don't count — if you think a knockout match will go to extra time, predict a draw.
seo_prizes_summary_ordinary_time.value: Todos los pronósticos son para el marcador al final de los 90 minutos (más el tiempo agregado). El tiempo extra y la tanda de penales no cuentan — si crees que un partido de eliminación directa se irá a tiempo extra, pronostica empate.

seo_prizes_summary_predict_each_match.comment: Bullet describing the core gameplay action in the FotMob Predict World Cup 2026 prizes summary. "Result" here means the final score outcome (win/draw/loss + score). "Kickoff" is the football term for match start — use the locale's football-specific term ("coup d'envoi", "Anpfiff", etc.), not a generic "before the match starts". Preserve "World Cup" verbatim.

seo_xpts_explanation.comment: Explanation of the xG table. The text has newline separators in it.
seo_xpts_explanation.english:
Expected Points (xPts) reflect the number of points a team was expected to earn from a match, based on the quality of their chances measured by Expected Goals (xG).

xPts for a match are calculated by simulating possible outcomes using the quality of shots, expressed as xG. The simulation awards points for wins, draws, or losses based on xG.

The xPts are accumulated over the season to form the 'xG-table', also known as the 'Justice table', which provides an alternative view of team performance beyond actual points earned.
seo_xpts_explanation.value:
Los puntos esperados (xPts) reflejan el número de puntos que se espera que un equipo obtenga en un partido, según la calidad de sus oportunidades medidas por los goles esperados (xG).

Los xPts de un partido se calculan simulando los posibles resultados mediante la calidad de los tiros, expresada en xG. La simulación otorga puntos por las victorias, los empates o las derrotas según los xG.

Los xPts se acumulan a lo largo de la temporada para crear la «tabla xG», también conocida como la «tabla de la justicia», que ofrece una vista alternativa del rendimiento de un equipo más allá de los puntos reales que haya obtenido.
